exposure: Two groups of women identified based on SAP response to supine position: those with an initial drop in SAP and those with an initial increase.
cohort: Healthy pregnant women undergoing planned cesarean delivery at Oslo University Hospital
finding: A 3-minute supine observation period before cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia can identify a subset of women who experience a drop in systolic arterial pressure, potentially indicating an increased risk of hypotension.
